include: The plan uses the layers panel order as the code has it: rows list layers frontmost first, so the layers stacked above a mask come after it in its parent's child list (paint order) and before it in the rows.

Which layers a mask clips is worked out from the parent's child list in paint order (back to front: later children paint above), and the plan converts between rows and paint order where the panel is involved.
Groups have an opacity of their own that multiplies into their children when they render; the plan treats the opacity of the group a mask sits in that way.
Making a shape a mask, and undoing that, is one undoable command, and the mask flag is saved with the document.
The plan says how hit testing treats the parts of clipped layers that the mask hides.
avoid: Treating the layers list as back to front (row 0 the backmost layer), for example taking the rows below the mask in the panel as the layers above it.
Saying groups have no opacity of their own, or pushing a group's opacity onto the layers inside it.
